settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Limits and financial years. A setting is never edited: each change starts on its date and the earlier values stay in the history.
settings.readOnly: You can see the settings but not change them. Ask Admin to change a setting or open a financial year.
settings.historyHelp: Every value this setting has had, newest first, with who set it and why.
settings.historyEmpty: No value has been set yet.
settings.formHelp: The new value starts on the date you choose; until then the current value applies. The change and its reason go into the user log.

limits.title: Limits Admin fixes for everyone
limits.help: These apply across all companies. A value the owner or CA has not decided yet stays unset until they decide.
limits.cashReceiptBlock: Cash receipt refused from one person in a day, at or above (₹)
limits.cashPaymentWarn: Cash payment warning, above this to one person in a day (₹)
limits.entriesBackdate: How many days back an entry may be dated

company.title: Company settings
company.help: Settings that differ between the companies.

fy.title: Financial years
fy.help: April to March, IST. Opening a year creates its 12 monthly periods; months are closed at month-end.
fy.openHelp: Creates the year from 1 April to 31 March and its 12 monthly periods. It can't be undone.
fy.empty: No financial year yet. Ask Admin to open one.
fy.emptyAdmin: No financial year yet. Open the current one to start numbering and entries.

f.keyHelp: Small letters, dots and underscores, e.g. area.name.
f.fromHelp: Today or a later date. Earlier values stay in the history.

err.key: Use small letters, dots and underscores.
err.year: Choose the company and a year such as 2026.
